name: pitstop
description: Long-term memory across sessions and harnesses. Hands each lifecycle event to the installed pitstop binary, which applies your capture exclusions and sends a sanitized record only to your pitstop server (default http://127.0.0.1:49374). Adds the pitstop MCP tools. No telemetry. Requires the pitstop binary, 3.0 or later. In Cowork, capture runs on your computer and needs pitstop installed there; the memory tools still work.

server_url.title: pitstop server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the pitstop server. Leave empty to use the server_url from your pitstop config (http://127.0.0.1:49374 for a local install).

pitstop_bin.title: pitstop executable
pitstop_bin.description: Absolute path to the pitstop binary, only needed when it is not on PATH. A relative path is ignored.

data_dir.title: pitstop data directory
data_dir.description: Only for an install that uses a non-default data directory.
